caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rectangular structure with two vertical side panels and a flat top panel, all rendered in shades of brown. The top panel contains six evenly spaced circular holes, each fitted with a cylindrical metallic or glass container that extends downward through a supporting horizontal shelf. The containers are colored in a muted greenish tone, and each has a small knob or cap visible at the top, with narrow nozzle-like extensions at the bottom. The side panels have semicircular cutouts at the base, and the overall structure is depicted on a plain off-white background, centered within a double-bordered beige frame.
title: Candle Mold
